problem:
Find the standard matrix that represents  the  linear  transformation $T$, where

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}3y+x \\ y-x\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
First, rewrite the order of the variables in the usual way:

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}x+3y \\ -x+y\end{aligned}]
$$

We require a $2\times 2$ matrix $T$ such that
    

$$
T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}x+3y \\ -x+y\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}x+3y \\ -x+y\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$
